create_expr_lookup: create a lookup set of Expr method signatures for a given namespace to enable expression dispatch
test_call_expr: test the call_expr decorator that wraps a Series method to dispatch it through the Expr API
refactor_get_ffi_func: refactor the get_ffi_func helper to dynamically resolve dtype-specific FFI functions on a PySeries object
review_with_no_check_length: review the _with_no_check_length wrapper that temporarily disables length checks while executing a function
